description: Create and edit videos with prompts. Rendley can use your footage, files, links, and other context to cut clips, repurpose content, resize videos for different formats, add captions, or create something entirely new. Then open the project in the editor and fine-tune anything you want.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Rendley to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Rendley to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.rendley.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Rendley MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rendley provides these MCP tools: add_brand_colors, add_files, create_video_draft, get_brandkit, get_project, list_projects, list_workspaces, and plan_video.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Rendley?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Rendley in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
